integrity: The theorem and proof are fully contained in RESULT.md; the standalone rational-arithmetic checker is a consistency test and does not replace the infinite-dimensional argument. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal spacing and equal least-squares weights are assumed. Sharp Lipschitz values are proved through five samples; for larger dimensions only monotonicity and an asymptotic lower bound are proved, not an optimal all-size constant. Priority over unindexed literature is not certified.
title: Five-point nonlocal instability and a persistent lower bound for convex least-squares projection
